title: I spent 6 months making my 2D tornado game. Claude rebuilt it in 3D in 2 days.
author: YuriyBezgin
selftext:
I'd been working on The Big Suck for six months when I gave the existing 2D PixiJS version to Claude Opus 5.5 and asked it to rebuild it in Unity 6.

The brief was to keep the gameplay, progression and UI, and turn the world into 3D. The original game was the reference, including its 277 upgrades and 16 tornado forms. The two days were for that rebuild; the design and progression were already there.

For the comparison shots, we replayed the same tornado path in both versions.

It's an incremental game where you ARE the tornado: wreck farms and towns, cash in the destruction, buy upgrades, and come back as a bigger disaster.

If that sounds like your kind of game, you can [wishlist The Big Suck on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4901860/The_Big_Suck/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=aigamedev_2d_to_3d&utm_content=post).

Does the 3D version make the destruction feel more satisfying, or is the 2D version easier to read?

comments.author: Droooomp
comments.body: 3d is cool , but 3rd person view is tough for the expirience , i love katamari damacy but it takes time to get used to its 3d navigation and after hundreds of hours i still loathe the camera movement in it. While Donut County is a good approach tbh, 3d  but with fixed camera works well.

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: I personally think it looks great, a big upgrade. The original style just wasnt super compelling. you can be 2d without looking flat, but the original looked flat.

comments.author: ZymzAlchemy
comments.body:
These both look really cool. While this is an excellent tech demo, personally I liked the old one, the art just needed some polish but the 3D one looks like alot imo. ymmv. 

Be well, keep creating.

replies.author: YuriyBezgin
replies.body: Yes, I think I'll keep the old one and maybe add a Unity version as a mode later

comments.author: Afterlight_Games
comments.body: Did you use Claude to make the trailer too??

replies.author: YuriyBezgin
replies.body:
Not the Steam trailer. I did it manually to sync with the music and record natural movements instead of scripted.   
But the video in this post is made with Opus, yes

comments.author: babaganoosh43
comments.body:
Agree 3D looks better, gameplay-wise depends on the camera controls.

Was Claude able to fully create the game with minimal touching of the IDE?

replies.author: YuriyBezgin
replies.body:
I didn't touch the IDE, but had to push it to fix bugs and add missing mechanics. There were two sessions to get the working prototype \~20h and \~5h  
I think it needs months of rebalancing and tuning to call the Unity version finished.
